subject: Request: Temporary P1/P2 SLA carveout & escalation path for AtlasPay migration
messages:
From: priyom.das@redwood.ai
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@atlaspay.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Temporary P1/P2 SLA carveout & escalation path for AtlasPay migration

Team —

AtlasPay's go-live window is next week and they've asked for a short-term change to our support response commitments during the database migration cutover (heavy write traffic + schema backfill). They want: 1) P1 response scope tightened (on-call primary to acknowledge within 5 min, aim 15 min mitigation window) and 2) guarantee that a senior on-call engineer is available as the first escalation for the 4-hour migration window (Nov 12, 02:00–06:00 PST).

We agreed to a provisional carveout in yesterday's call, but Procurement needs written authorization and an internal approval chain for the escalation path before we sign the amendment.

Ask: can we approve a temporary SLA amendment (cover starts Nov 12 02:00 PST, ends Nov 13 06:00 PST) with these constraints:
- Redwood provides dedicated on-call senior escalation (SRE level) for migration window
- Any P1 requiring code rollback triggers immediate paging of engineering leadership (Ben, Marissa)
- We attach the migration runbook and the SLA amendment draft to the DocuSign package

Attachments: AtlasPay_Migration_Runbook_v1.3.pdf (runbook), SLA_Amendment_Draft_AtlasPay.docx (amendment language).

Samir (cc'd) — please confirm the migration start time and whether AtlasPay will accept a carveout limited to the 28-hour period above.

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das | Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Subject: Re: Request: Temporary P1/P2 SLA carveout & escalation path for AtlasPay migration

Ack — looking. A couple of clarifying Qs before I sign off:

1) Does AtlasPay expect any sustained latency SLA relaxation for P2s during the entire migration window, or only the immediate 4-hour cutover? We should be explicit in the amendment.
2) Who is the 'senior on-call' on our side? If we commit SRE-level, we need a named owner and a backup.
3) What triggers paging of leadership vs. routing to SRE? I want to avoid leadership being paged for noisy alerts.

If the runbook shows clear rollback criteria and a small blast radius, I can provisionally approve the carveout and list myself as the leadership pager. Olga — can you confirm an SRE assignation and whether this fits into the existing on-call rota (or if we need a swap)?

Ben
Ben Carter | Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference

On Thu, Nov 05, 2026 at 10:05 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Ack — looking. A couple of clarifying Qs before I sign off:
>
> 1) Does AtlasPay expect any sustained latency SLA relaxation for P2s during the entire migration window, or only the immediate 4-hour cutover?

Olga here — runbook shows two active periods: the 4-hour cutover (02:00–06:00 PST on Nov 12) and a 24-hour post-cutover observation period. AtlasPay asked for tighter P1 acknowledgement during the 4-hour cutover only; they are requesting we accept probabilistic P2 latency variance during the 24-hour observation window (we should call that out).

I can put forward SRE on-call assignment:
- Primary SRE: olga.petrov@redwood.ai (assigned)
- Backup SRE: marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Escalation rule proposal (compact):
- P1: Pager to Primary SRE (ack within 5 min). If unacknowledged in 10 min -> page Backup SRE. If unresolved after 30 min -> page Ben (head of reliability). If unresolved after 60 min -> page Marissa (VP ops) and open incident bridge.
- P2 during cutover: route to on-call engineer with 60-min response SLA; during 24-hour observation accept 2x latency variance but keep 4-hour manual review window.

I can cover the primary shift for the cutover if Marissa is OK to be listed as backup.

Olga
Olga Petrov | Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@atlaspay.com>, Laura Ng <laura.ng@atlaspay.com>, Procurement <procurement@atlaspay.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary P1/P2 SLA carveout & escalation path for AtlasPay migration

Thanks for the details — I approve a provisional carveout subject to two conditions:

1) We include specific rollback/stop-the-line criteria in the DocuSign amendment (runbook section 4). If those criteria are hit we revert to prior stable deployment and Redwood retains normal SLA posture; the carveout is void.
2) AtlasPay signs the limited-duration amendment and acknowledges the observed-variance period (24 hours post-cutover) with explicit acceptance of increased P2 latency risk.

I'll be the signatory on the amendment for operations and will act as secondary leadership escalation if Ben is unavailable. Priyom — please send the DocuSign link with the attached runbook and amendment draft; Procurement needs a single signed PDF.

Marissa Cole
VP, Global Operations | Redwood Inference
